review.reason: The mapped course layout, hazards, tees, greens, and property outline are clearly represented. The detached Hole 3 fairway patch lacks clearly visible alternating mowing stripes at thumbnail scale, so the illustration does not meet the fairway-stripe requirement.

issues.detail: The short detached fairway patch between T3 and G3 appears largely uniform; alternating edge-to-edge mowing stripes are not clearly visible.
issues.consequence: The patch may read as unstriped turf or an extra green-like surface rather than as fairway, making the overview less clear.
